_instructions: Spec template for `kappmaker create-mascot --states-spec <file>` — stage 2, the 4×4 grid showing the CHOSEN mascot (passed as reference image) in 16 emotional/situational states.

This is a proven BASELINE, not a rigid schema — enrich freely. TWO mechanical constraints are fixed: the output MUST stay a single 4×4 grid, and `states` MUST list exactly 16 entries in grid order (left→right, top→bottom) — the CLI names the sliced files after this list.
The mascot's identity, style, colors and proportions must stay IDENTICAL across all cells — only expression, pose and small effects change.
Pick states that map to real app UI moments (loading, success, error, empty, onboarding, streak, paywall…). Backgrounds white/transparent; NO text anywhere.

grid_layout.arrangement: A single high-resolution image: 4×4 grid, the SAME mascot in one clearly readable state per cell, centered with uniform padding and safe margins so cells can be cleanly split, consistent perspective and scale.
grid_layout.background: white or transparent — supports the emotion without distracting

consistency_rules: Identity, style, colors, proportions and overall design identical across all 16 cells
No new styles, outfits, or redesigns — no changes to body shape, face structure or palette beyond small expressive variations
Emotion expressed through facial expression, body language, posture and subtle visual cues
Lighting and minor effects may vary subtly per emotion, never enough to break visual consistency
Each cell reads like a collectible expression of the same mascot
constraints: NO TEXT WHATSOEVER: no words, letters, numbers, icons with text meaning, UI elements, speech bubbles, emojis, watermarks or logos
